description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointing Justice Hector Yapa to be the Chairman & Justice Nimal Dissanayake, Justice Chandradasa Nanayakkara, Mr. Somasundaram & Mrs. Faleela Be Jurangpathy as Commissioners of the Mediation Boards Commission with immediate effect
reasoning: This gazette announces the appointment of Commissioners to the Mediation Boards Commission, specifically naming individuals (including retired judges) to serve on this judicial/legal body. The content involves judicial appointments (retired Supreme Court and Court of Appeal judges) to a commission established under the Mediation Boards Act, which falls under judicial/law enforcement matters rather than general government personnel changes.
